title: Anand Seamless IPO Details
intro:
Anand Seamless IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹25.52 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 35.44 lakh shares of ₹25.52 crore.

Anand Seamless IPO opens for subscription on Sep 22, 2026 and closes on Sep 24, 2026. The allotment for the Anand Seamless IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 25, 2026. Anand Seamless IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 29, 2026.

Anand Seamless IPO is set final issue price at ₹72 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,30,400 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,45,600.

Aftertrade Broking Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Aftertrade Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Anand Seamless IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2005, Anand Seamless Limited is engaged in the production of seamless tubes, pipes, and finned tubes used in industrial applications. The company operates in the iron and steel manufacturing sector. The company specializes in manufacturing carbon steel and alloy steel seamless tubes, heat exchanger tubes, U-tubes, and various types of finned tubes. These products are widely used in industries such as oil & gas, petrochemicals, power plants, and process industries.

The company cater to both the domestic as well as the international markets. In the domestic market, we sell our Products to Heat Exchanger Industry, Petroleum Industries, Pharmaceutical Industries, Chemical Industries, Oil and Gas Refineries Railways, Thermal & Nuclear Power Plants, Boiler Manufacturing, Chemical Industries, Textile Machinery, and Transportation sectors, Automobile Industries, Defense Sector, Cement Industries.
The company operate at their owned manufacturing unit situated at Survey No. 944, Chhatral Kadi Road, Nr. Ankhol Patiya, Indrad, Kadi, Gujarat 382715, India.

As of March 31, 2026, the company employs 81 permanent employees and engages 57 contractual personnel at the Unit I facility and, 19 permanent employees and 10 contractual personnel at the Unit II facility.

faqs.question: How to apply in Anand Seamless IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Anand Seamless IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Anand Seamless IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Anand Seamless IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Anand Seamless IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Anand Seamless IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Anand Seamless IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Anand Seamless IPO will be done on Friday, September 25, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 28, 2026 . Check the Anand Seamless IPO allotment status .
